turns.user_message: What cleanup events are happening this month?
turns.assistant_answer:
While there aren't any specific cleanup events listed for this month, there are a few other happenings that might be of interest to our Dorchester neighbors.

Looking ahead to the end of July, the Boston Ballet is hosting "Open Studio Days" on July 28th, 29th, and 30th. These events are a great chance for families with young children, ages 16 months to 6 years, to try a free class, meet the faculty, and explore their studios. You can find more details and sign up at bostonballet.org/dorchester-enroll.

Also on July 29th, from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM, there's a "Virtual Baby Cafe" hosted by Codman Square Health Center. You can register for this online event by calling (857)-301-8259.

Towards the end of the month, on July 30th, Codman Square Health Center is also offering a "Recharge! Middle School Therapy Group" in Randolph. This group runs from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM and is designed to provide a supportive space for middle schoolers to build friendships and develop skills for managing emotions. For more information, you can contact CodmanRandolph@codman.org. That same evening, July 30th, from 6:00 PM to 7:30 PM, the Climate Justice Alliance is having a party at Oasis on Ballou Farm. It sounds like a fun celebration with music, dancing, and a seedling and tree giveaway, with food and drinks provided.

As we move into August, the "Open Streets Boston" event is scheduled for Jamaica Plain on August 2nd, running from 10:30 AM to 3:00 PM. This event will close streets to vehicular traffic, creating a space for community activities.
